changes: Active offering, account, setup and library copy distinguishes Agent Feeds from Agent Feeds + Harness Files. The existing plan identifier, price and entitlements are unchanged. Approved historical Terms retain their original wording.
Homepage, audience pages, directories and deck share the light/dark appearance tokens; the appearance preference stores only a theme enum per origin.

Thirteen decision-oriented source collections link twenty-eight primary references and expose twenty-eight JSON Feed/Markdown downloads. These are release-curated source directories, not daily findings or personalized subscriptions.
Homepage scenarios now distinguish recorded catalogue evidence from worked examples, use consistent exact-version digests and omit unsupported large-row/time outcome claims.
Source-directory faults no longer break unrelated health, homepage or account routes. The edge forwards unsupported query-bearing feed requests to the origin refusal.

HTTP client profiles are wired through the existing periodic collector executors; the separately installed scheduler remains pinned to the preceding revision pending explicit evidence-state migration.
The scheduler installer refuses replacement while its timer or service is active. The organizational opportunity projection remains private and sends no outreach.

cloudflare.body_storage: Fly volume; pinned R2 mirroring is incomplete and not selected for serving
cloudflare.route_rollback: Disable proxying on the same saved DNS records; retain Worker, routes and stored objects.

post_cutover_browser.scope: Each newly proxied host was checked after its own cutover. The existing docs route was included in the ten-host release pass.

checks.billing_label_readback: Authenticated read of the existing plan reports Agent Feeds + Harness Files; no checkout or payment was performed.

limits: Personalized saved feeds, per-agent assignments, scheduled research delivery and a separate feed-only paid plan are not implemented by the offering copy.
The application and static export add no catalogue component files. Twenty-four separately reviewed SDG packages remain staged, not served.
The two-offering migration does not amend approved legal Terms. No customer-authentication provider migration was performed.
New search credentials have bounded transport probes only; their in-progress adapter/accounting work is not included in this release or activated in the scheduler.
The R2 mirror remains bound to the unchanged catalogue inventory and original request/time ceilings; copying existing files is not catalogue growth.
